rule.description: A function or method matches when its named parameters (excluding self, cls and variadic catch-alls) share at least three names with the named parameters of another distinct function or method defined anywhere in the same production package (src/). The relation is symmetric: every participating signature is reported on its own line by the Pylint message W9901 data_clump_shared_parameter_group.
rule.definition_source: Pylint plugin loaded by smell_check.sh; parameter lists are recovered from the Pylint-parsed syntax trees of the production modules and compared pairwise across the whole package.

checks.description: Detect every signature that forwards a group of three or more named parameters which another distinct signature of the same production package also forwards.
checks.detected_relation: signature -> shared parameter group (>=3 concurrent names) with another signature in the same package
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The same setting names are passed jointly through several independent signatures instead of traveling as one cohesive grouping, so every component boundary re-declares the group and callers must repeat the members at every call.

matches.evidence: CNNCifar.__init__ receives (num_channels, num_filters, num_classes), exactly the group its two sibling architectures also receive.
CNNFashion_Mnist.__init__ accepts the convolution shape group (num_channels, num_filters, num_classes) that it does not even consume, so the group is pure call-site decoration.
CNNMnist.__init__ takes (num_channels, num_filters, num_classes), the same three-name model-shaping group passed to the other two architectures.

LocalUpdate.__init__ receives (dataset, idxs, local_bs) together with the rest of the local training group (local_ep, lr, optimizer, verbose, gpu), and forwards the loader-slicing subset to its own loader-building signature.
LocalUpdate.train_val_test re-declares (dataset, idxs, local_bs) instead of reading the batch setting through the trainer's own grouped state.
exp_details lists ten individual settings, of which (dataset, lr, optimizer, local_bs, local_ep) overlap the local trainer's declaration and the rest overlap the dataset loader's declaration.
get_dataset takes (dataset, num_users, iid, unequal) beside the directory root; (dataset, num_users, iid) are the same names the experiment report consumes.

excluded.reason: Each user-group sampler receives only (dataset, num_users) - a two-name group - so it stays below the three-name threshold; the samplers already form an adequate grouping and were left unchanged.

The perceptron's geometry triple is independently constructed from the loaded image shape at both entry points and shares no names with any other signature; it is unrelated to the experiment-settings groups.
The dataset and its index subset travel as a two-name pair below the threshold; only the trainer-level wiring that repeats this pair alongside a settings member participates.
These command line settings are consumed by no production component at this revision; threading them into components would add unused parameters, not a repeated data group.
